title: encrypt(): missing Panics section for RSA + OS RNG failure
description: encrypt() can panic via UnwrapErr(SysRng) in build_rsa_recipient when RSA recipient is used and OS RNG fails. Public doc shows # Errors (returns Result) but has no # Panics section. Library users expect Result-returning functions not to panic. Fix: add # Panics section to encrypt() doc explaining this is unreachable in practice (OS RNG failure = catastrophic system state) but technically possible.
